paper: Empirical Asset Pricing with Large Language Model Agents
headline_mechanism: AAPM iteratively refines stock and macro news reports with memory, embeds and smooths those reports, combines them with asset embeddings and manual characteristics in a historically pretrained nonlinear pricing network, and ranks predicted excess returns into portfolios.

source_anchors.claim: The agent iteratively refines latest-news analysis using external memory and continuously updated macro and micro notes.
Smoothed report embeddings are concatenated with manual financial factors and asset-specific embeddings.
The pricing network is pretrained on historical factor data before report embeddings become available and predicts next excess returns.
Expected returns form tangency, equal-weighted, and value-weighted long-short portfolios; VW uses top and bottom deciles.

preserved_elements: separate stock-report and macro-report state blocks
nonlinear hybrid interactions and value-weighted decile portfolio
approximated_elements: price, attention, and quality characteristics replace unavailable WSJ stock reports
formation-time market return, volatility, and breadth replace macro notes and report embeddings
per-security smoothed characteristic states replace learned BGE report embeddings and memory retrieval
size, value, and profitability ranks replace learned asset embeddings
fixed tanh interaction features plus rolling ridge replace the deep pricing network
invented_elements: the deterministic nonlinear interaction map and ridge penalty
common transaction costs and missing-return sensitivity
portfolio_adapter: The predicted excess-return score uses the paper's value-weighted top/bottom decile rule under the frozen top-1,000 monthly universe, with common 10 bp one-way cost and missingness handling.
claim_boundary: This is a researcher-authored AAPM-inspired hybrid pricing model, not the unavailable WSJ corpus, LLM reports, BGE embeddings, trained network, native predictions, or paper results.
